answers.question: 158 Q1 · Where should you be able to approve native permission requests from background and worker loops? The owning machine must keep the native request alive. This choice determines the remote authorization and delivery work in story 158; ordinary business-question answers will never grant permission.
answers.answer: I don't need to approve, you need to approve on my behalf. Just like claude does

answers.question: 158 Q2 · Codex’s permission-scope requests grant access for an entire turn, rather than one operation. Should story 158 allow that scope when clearly displayed? Commands and file changes still use “Approve once”; session-wide grants and permanent policy changes remain excluded.
answers.answer: No dude. The approval is implicit by the user running the loop/graph
